_comment: Provenance values recognised by validate_yaml.py. `official: true` means the value passes --strict-aws-official; `official: false` means it fails. `manual` (legacy) is treated as an alias for `manual-human` for backwards compatibility with YAMLs created before the split.

aws-security-hub.description: AWS Security Hub describe-standards-controls or list-security-control-definitions API

aws-audit-manager.description: AWS Audit Manager get-control / get-assessment-framework API

aws-config-managed-rule-doc.description: AWS Config developer guide page for a managed rule (docs.aws.amazon.com/config/.../<rule>.html)

aws-guard-registry.description: AWS CloudFormation Guard Rules Registry test fixtures or framework mappings (aws-cloudformation/aws-guard-rules-registry)

manual-human.description: Hand-authored by a human reading AWS-official source material. Verifiable by an external auditor following the cited URLs.

manual-model-synthesised.description: Generated by a language model from training-corpus AWS knowledge. Not directly verifiable; relies on model fidelity to public AWS docs.

manual.description: Legacy alias for manual-human. New rules should prefer the explicit form. Treated as official for backwards compatibility.

unknown.description: Source not recorded. Always fails strict mode.
